# CrowdPing — llms.txt
# https://crowdping.aiinnovisory.com
# Last updated: 2026-09-22

> CrowdPing is a free live audience-polling tool. An organiser asks a question, projects a
> QR code, and the room answers instantly — no app to download and no sign-up for
> participants. Results appear as live percentage bars as votes come in. Built for workshops,
> talks, classrooms, and any live event where you want an honest, real-time read on what a
> room actually thinks.

## Maker
Built by Peter Mangin, founder of AI Innovisory (https://aiinnovisory.com), an Auckland-based
AI advisory firm. CrowdPing grew out of running AI workshops for 400+ New Zealand
organisations and needing a fast, frictionless way to poll a room live.

## How it works
1. Sign in and create a poll: one question, up to eight answers.
2. Publish it — get a QR code and a short link.
3. Project the QR code; the audience scans it and votes, no account needed.
4. Watch results update live as percentages, without exposing raw vote counts to the audience.

## Key page
